ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 75% high-intensity white and 25% low-intensity black/dark grey pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large dark contiguous region centered at the peduncle junction; numerous discrete, small circular black blobs scattered throughout the white mid-sections of both lobes; fine, dense linear pigmentation patterns localized near the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Frequent, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of approximately 5-12 pixels; distinct peaks and valleys observed along the trailing edge of the right lobe; left lobe trailing edge contains minor jaggedness and one prominent indentation near the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a strong upward convex trajectory along the visible edges with a slight concave sweep on the trailing boundary toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple discrete, high-contrast dark circular pixel clusters (3-10 pixel diameter) distributed across the white ventral background of both lobes, primarily in the medial regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A set of 4-5 parallel, dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the upper portion of the right lobe's white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel rake marks on the trailing section of the right lobe; irregular jagged edges on the distal tips indicating minor tissue degradation or previous trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique whorl-like or concentric linear pigmentation patterns located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, resembling fingerprint-like structures.
